request.description: Update a DRAFT invoice only. Finalized invoices must be cancelled and recreated.

Cancel an invoice. When cancelling a finalized invoice, the system reverses the associated Ledger Entry (marks it as RETURN), marks the linked Udhar Entry as CANCELLED, and updates the ledger description with 'CANCELLED: [original description]'.
